Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Name: Declaration of War
Cardtype: Political Action
Requires a ready archbishop, cardinal or regent.
Successful referendum means each Methuselah loses 1 pool for each ready Sabbat vampire controlled by his or her predator. Pool lost this way is divided and allocated evenly (round down; unallocated pool goes to the blood bank) between each Methuselah controlling at least one ready Sabbat vampire. Seraphs have 1 additional vote in this referendum. Only one Declaration of War can be played or called in a game.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
> Non-existant user wrote:
> Shouldn't the pool gain happen before the pool loss to avoid fake ousts? It would be more complicated to word that way, though.
>
The Eternal of Sirius precedent (you can play it at 4 pool without being ousted) may mean this will not cause trouble.

I'm not too thrilled. Toreador Palla Grande does not need this, and while it is fitting for sabbat to have strength by number, the overall feel is not too flavorful or exciting.

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body: They are archbishop as small as 4-cap or 5-cap, Creations rites is already a pretty sweet card for swarming, and without swarming the card is way too random - with a full sabbat table you will do next to nothing, and you may end up with an unplayable vote if your predator swarm with sabbat - blood brother and !tore spring to mind, but other may be bad too.
